summary_1line: Agastya recounts the severe penances of Ravana, Vibhishana, and Kumbhakarna and the boons Brahma grants them, shaping their future roles.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana slices off one of his heads and offers it into a blazing sacrificial fire during his thousand‑year austerity.
Brahma appears before Ravana as the demon prepares to sever his final head after ten thousand years of penance.
Saraswati enters Kumbhakarna’s mouth as he speaks before Brahma, causing him to ask for endless sleep instead of a mighty boon.
